state.goal: Research Hetzner fit and current baseline pricing for a modern AI SaaS architecture

found.text:
Hetzner’s official Object Storage overview explains its billing and points to the current pricing page. Hetzner’s traffic page lists included traffic for CX Cloud Servers and Cloud Load Balancers. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/))
Sources:
[s1] Overview - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/

Hetzner’s PostgreSQL documentation describes databases managed through its konsoleH web-hosting interface, not a managed PostgreSQL service with Cloud-specific pricing. I didn’t find an official Hetzner page listing managed PostgreSQL Cloud prices. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/managed/databases/postgresql/))
Sources:
[s2] PostgreSQL - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/managed/databases/postgresql/

Hetzner Cloud official docs:

Features and API: Servers, networks, firewalls, volumes, load balancers, and related resources are covered in the Cloud API docs. ([docs.hetzner.cloud](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud))

Locations: The locations guide lists data centers and which services are available at each location. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/general/locations/))

Volumes: Block storage can be attached to Cloud Servers; billing is hourly with a monthly price cap. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/volumes/overview/))

Load balancers: The official API docs describe load-balancer types and management. ([docs.hetzner.cloud](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud))

Object Storage: S3-compatible storage is available in Falkenstein, Nuremberg, and Helsinki; the docs explain endpoints and pricing. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/))

Pricing: Consult the official Volumes and Object Storage pricing pages for current rates; Cloud resource billing details are also documented in the relevant product guides. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/volumes/overview/))
Sources:
[s3] Hetzner Cloud API — https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud
[s4] Locations - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/general/locations/
[s5] Overview - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/volumes/overview/
[s6] Overview - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage
Hetzner’s official 2026 price adjustment took effect on June 15, 2026 for new orders and cloud-server rescaling. For CX23, the listed monthly price is €5.49 in Germany/Finland or $6.49 in US locations; hourly rates are €0.0088 and $0.0104, respectively. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/general/infrastructure-and-availability/price-adjustment/))

For current LB11 and Object Storage pricing, check Hetzner’s official product pages; rates can depend on location and usage. ([hetzner.com](https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/load-balancer/?country=si))
Sources:
[s7] Hetzner Price Adjustment 15 June 2026 - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/general/infrastructure-and-availability/price-adjustment/
[s8] Load Balancer — https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/load-balancer/?country=si

Hetzner’s official price adjustment effective June 15, 2026 lists these monthly prices in Germany/Finland: CX23 $6.49, CPX22 $22.99, and CCX23 $101.49. Prices exclude IPv4 and VAT. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/general/infrastructure-and-availability/price-adjustment/))

Singapore pricing differs: CPX22 is $30.99/month and CCX23 is $127.99/month; CX23 isn’t listed for Singapore. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/general/infrastructure-and-availability/price-adjustment/))
Sources:
[s9] Hetzner Price Adjustment 15 June 2026 - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/general/infrastructure-and-availability/price-adjustment/

Hetzner Object Storage starts at €4.99/month, including 1 TB of storage and 1 TB of egress traffic. Additional storage is €0.0067 per TB-hour—about €4.90 per TB for a 730-hour month. Prices exclude VAT. ([hetzner.com](https://www.hetzner.com/pressroom/object-storage/))
Sources:
[s10] Hetzner Object Storage: modern storage solution for growing amounts of data — https://www.hetzner.com/pressroom/object-storage/
